solutions.title: Find candidate row then search it
solutions.strategy: Find the row whose range can contain the target, then binary search within that row.

timeComplexity.explanation: The row scan can inspect m rows, followed by binary search over n columns.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only indexes and bounds are stored.

solutions.title: Flattened binary search
solutions.strategy: Treat the matrix as one sorted array and translate flat indexes to row/column coordinates.

timeComplexity.explanation: Binary search halves the flattened search space each step.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only binary search bounds are stored.
